thread:
ellis: Quick heads-up — scheduling a TTL retention backfill + partial-index rebuild on orders_events during the change window tomorrow (02:50-03:40 UTC). Job will stream ~4.3M rows across 3 partitions. We need a brief quiesce for the index swap.

 nina: Thanks. Can you confirm the service pin/version and the exact holdpoint? we should pin API workers to v2.5.0-rc3 for the window.

 ellis: Yes, pin to `v2.5.0-rc3`. Holdpoint: STOP before index swap at 03:25 UTC; validation checks then swap. I'll add the release-note snippet.

 deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by ellis for 3300012346 at 2026-04-02T02:55:00Z. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 3300012346`. To abort running job: `/deploy abort <job-id>`.

 devon: Recommend canary on partition p1 for 6 minutes, then stagger p2/p3. Set feature flag `orders_ttl_rebuild=true` during the job. Canary success criteria: no locks >4s, replica lag <3s, write p99 <200ms.

 oncall-ops: I'll add a temporary alert for long locking queries and replica lag. Can someone paste the queries?

 devon: Use these preflight queries:
```
-- long row-level locks
SELECT now(), pid, usename, wait_event_type, wait_event, query
FROM pg_stat_activity a
JOIN pg_locks l USING (pid)
WHERE l.mode ~ 'Exclusive' AND a.state <> 'idle';

-- rows to process
SELECT count(*) FROM orders_events WHERE created_at < now() - interval '120 days';
```

 nina: Preflight service checks: `curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/v1/service/version` and on host: `psql -c "SELECT current_setting('service.release');"`

 prod-sre: Also ensure we have a safepoint snapshot in case of rollback. I'll create `snap_orders_pre_backfill_3300012346`.

 deploy-bot: canary run started on partition p1 (job id jb_11224). Logs: https://deploy/logs/jb_11224. Monitor with `/deploy status jb_11224`.

 ellis: Watching logs now. A few dead rows cleaned up, write latency steady. prod-sre please confirm snapshot exists.

 prod-sre: Snapshot done: snap_orders_pre_backfill_3300012346. Replication lag 0.6s. No long locks seen.

 devon: Emergency stop plan: `/deploy abort jb_11224` then on DB: `SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE '%orders_backfill%' AND state <> 'idle';` If that doesn't work: `pg_terminate_backend(pid)`.

 oncall-ops: Temp alert rule added: `orders:long_lock > 3s` and `replica_lag > 3s`. Will page if triggered.

 deploy-bot: job jb_11224 completed: status SUCCESS. duration 8m. processed ~1.1M rows on p1; errors: 0.

 nina: Nice. Proceeding to p2 at 03:05 UTC. I'll flip the feature flag and keep the pin.

 ellis: Final roll plan documented. Abort criteria repeated in the runbook and release notes. Final go/no-go at 02:45 UTC. Thanks all :shipit:
